Asset type: one independent square English vocabulary illustration, no card frame.
Exact supplied target sense: {"word": "when", "pos": "conj.", "meaning": "当...的时候"}.
Primary request and scene: A single tightly connected everyday vignette showing the temporal relation when the rain begins, a child opens an umbrella: a compact rain cloud directly overhead has just begun dropping visible raindrops, and directly below the child is raising an umbrella that is halfway opening. Show the coincident rain onset and umbrella-opening action clearly, with just a small patch of ground. Both events are equally legible and causally connected. This is a candidate for a temporal conjunction; do not insert a clock or alarm, and do not substitute a simple sleeping or waking scene.
Style/medium: hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper, cohesive gentle educational illustration.
Composition/framing: square image; one clear central subject or tightly related scene filling the middle 70 percent, generous warm-white negative space on all sides, soft-edged minimal background, clean silhouette readable on a small vocabulary card.
Lighting/color: soft natural daylight with muted green, blue, coral, and warm earthy accents; plausible forms and depth.
Constraints: absolutely no letters, words, numbers, written labels, logos, watermarks, borders or card UI anywhere; do not render the target word or Chinese meaning. Anatomically coherent hands and faces, no duplicated limbs, no unrelated decorations. Generate one new standalone raster illustration for this exact task only.
